fieldData.description: Join us at the community meet-up event in Gothenburg, Thursday, June 30th from 17:00 - 20:00! Come share a drink and some food with your fellow local community members and chat about crypto, DeFi, and of course Radix `DLT! Our first event we'll meet up and chat about anything, very casual, anyone is welcome.
